_note: Generated from CPython's str.casefold()/str.isspace(); the JS adapter applies these tables instead of toLowerCase()/trim(), which disagree with Python in both directions. Never generated from the JS implementation.

final_sigma._note: Operational classes for CPython handle_capital_sigma(), observed from str.lower() itself. `cased` means stop-and-cased (it is disjoint from `case_ignorable` by construction, because the skip test is applied first).
